rics.description: Domestic Vehicle Sales - Cars- Actual, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: Domestic Vehicle Sales, Cars — YoY change. Reuters poll-anchored 'actual' release tracking GAIKINDO car sales data.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia car market ~800k units/year. Toyota, Daihatsu, Honda dominate. Watch for YoY swings >20% as cycle inflection signal.

rics.meaning: Domestic Sales of Motorcycles — Indonesia is the world's third-largest motorcycle market behind India and China. ~5-6M units/year sold.
rics.how_to_use: Honda + Yamaha dominate (~95% combined market share). Tracks middle-class Indonesian household formation closely. Surges during commodity-export booms (rural-area income gains).

rics.meaning: Motor Vehicles, Domestic Sales of Cars — passenger car sales level (excludes commercial vehicles, motorcycles).
rics.how_to_use: Pre-2014 peak ~1.2M units; current ~800k. 'Middle-income trap' in autos — sustained mid-2010s stagnation reflects post-commodity-supercycle structural slowdown. Watch EV transition (Wuling, Hyundai launching local production).

rics.meaning: Motor Vehicles, Motorcycles — YoY change in motorcycle sales.
rics.how_to_use: Motorcycle YoY is one of the best high-frequency consumer-spending gauges for Indonesia. Tracks rural and small-business income closely. Honda/Yamaha report monthly to AISI (Indonesian Motorcycle Industry Association).
